text: Percival Deedes, Land Office. Property is the only treasure that doesn't sink.
Looking to put down roots, captain?
Ah, {player}. A pirate with a mortgage is a pirate who comes home.
How's the property treating you? Leak in the roof? Not my department.
Town's {town_mood}! Coin everywhere you look.
Never seen the harbour so busy.
Times are hard here. The town's {town_mood}.
Trade's dried up. If you've cargo to sell, sell it here; we need it.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: I want to run a tavern. (150 doubloons)
A headquarters for my crew. (300, from the crew chest)

text: Stand on open ground, away from the town's own buildings, and use the deed. Up it goes.
The plot is yours: nobody else breaks or opens anything inside. A headquarters is shared with your crew.
Taverns earn a share of the port's trade every day; the busier the town, the fatter the till. /home collect.
Walk home with /home go, once in a while. And if you tire of it, /home sell from inside.
